subject: general
question: A cube-shaped metal box of 1 kg mass is kept on the horizontal surface of a table. Assuming acceleration due to gravity is 10 m/sec², the thrust acting on the table surface is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 N**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The thrust acting on the table surface is equal to the **weight** of the metal box.
 
• The weight of an object can be calculated using the formula **Weight (W) = mass (m) x acceleration due to gravity (g)**.
 
• Here, the mass (m) of the metal box is **1 kg**.
 
• The acceleration due to gravity (g) is given as **10 m/sec²**.
 
• Therefore, the weight (W) = 1 kg x 10 m/sec² = **10 N**.
 
• Hence, the thrust acting on the table surface is **10 N**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Thrust**__

 __
 
• Thrust is the force exerted by an object perpendicular to the surface it is in contact with.
 
• In the context of weight, it is the gravitational force acting downward due to the object's mass.
 
 
 
• **Weight**__
 
 
• Weight is a measure of the force exerted by gravity on an object.
 
• It is dependent on both the mass of the object and the local gravitational field strength.
